00047 class BufferChannelInternal : public SmartPointer
00048 {
00049 public:
00050   BufferChannelInternal(const unsigned int size, bool zeroData = false) throw();
00051   BufferChannelInternal(const unsigned int size, const unsigned int sourceDataSize, const float* sourceData) throw();
00052   BufferChannelInternal(const unsigned int size, const double start, const double end) throw();
00053   ~BufferChannelInternal() throw();
00054   
00055   inline float getSampleUnchecked(const int index) const throw() { return data[index]; }
00056   inline float getSampleUnchecked(const double index) const throw() { return getSampleUnchecked((float)index); }
00057   inline float getSampleUnchecked(const float index) const throw() 
00058   { 
00059     const int iIndex0 = (int)index;
00060     unsigned int iIndex1 = iIndex0+1;
00061     if(iIndex1 >= size_)
00062       iIndex1 = 0;
00063     const float frac1 = (float)index - (float)iIndex0;
00064     const float frac0 = 1.f - frac1;
00065     
00066     return data[iIndex0] * frac0 + data[iIndex1] * frac1; // need to optimise this at some point    
00067   }

00422   template<class NumericalType>
00423   inline NumericalArray2D<NumericalType> toArray() const throw()
00424   {
00425     NumericalArray2D<NumericalType> array2d;
00426     
00427     if(channels != 0)
00428     {
00429       for(int i = 0; i < numChannels_; i++)
00430       {
00431         NumericalArray<float> array = NumericalArray<float>::withArray(size_, channels[i]->data, false);
00432         array2d << NumericalArray<NumericalType>(array);
00433       }
00434     }
00435     
00436     return array2d;
00437   }

00443     return toArray<NumericalType>(0);

00447   template<class NumericalType>
00448   inline NumericalArray<NumericalType> toArray(const int channel) const throw()
00449   {
00450     NumericalArray<NumericalType> array;
00451     
00452     if(channels != 0)
00453     {
00454       int channelToUse = channel;
00455       while(channelToUse < 0)
00456         channelToUse += numChannels_;
00457       
00458       NumericalArray<float> floatArray = NumericalArray<float>::withArray(size_, 
00459                                         channels[channel % numChannels_]->data, 
00460                                         false);
00461       array = floatArray;
00462     }
00463     
00464     return array;
00465   }

00699   inline void setCircularHead(const unsigned int blockID, const int channel, const int position) throw() 
00700   { 
00701     ugen_assert((channel >= 0) && (channel < numChannels_)); 
00702     BufferChannelInternal* internal = channels[channel];
00703     internal->previousCircularHead = internal->circularHead;
00704     internal->circularHead = position;

00706   }

00708   inline int getCircularHead(const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) const throw() 
00709   { 
00710     ugen_assert(channel >= 0); 
00711     BufferChannelInternal* internal = channels[channel % numChannels_];
00712     if(blockID == internal->currentWriteBlockID)
00713     {
00714       return internal->previousCircularHead;
00715     }
00716     else
00717     {
00718       return internal->circularHead;
00719     }
00720   }

00868   template<UnaryOpFunction op>
00869   Buffer unary() const throw()                                        
00870   {                                                           
00871     Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(size_, numChannels_, false));                             
00872     
00873     for(int channelIndex = 0; channelIndex < numChannels_; channelIndex++)                        
00874     {                                                         
00875       int numSamples = size_;                                           
00876       float* inputSamples = channels[channelIndex]->data;                               
00877       float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[channelIndex]->data;                          
00878       
00879       while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                            
00880         *outputSamples++ = op(*inputSamples++);                       
00881       }                                                     
00882     }                                                         
00883     
00884     return newBuffer;                                                 
00885   }

00904   Buffer binary(Buffer rightOperand) throw()
00905   {
00906     const int newNumChannels = numChannels_ > rightOperand.numChannels_ ? numChannels_ : rightOperand.numChannels_; 
00907     const int maxSize = size_ > rightOperand.size_ ? size_ : rightOperand.size_;                  
00908     const int minSize = size_ < rightOperand.size_ ? size_ : rightOperand.size_;                  
00909     const int diffSize = maxSize-minSize;                                     
00910     
00911     Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(maxSize, newNumChannels, false));                         
00912     
00913     for(int channelIndex = 0; channelIndex < newNumChannels; channelIndex++)                    
00914     {                                                       
00915       int numSamples;                                               
00916       float* leftSamples = channels[channelIndex % numChannels_]->data;                     
00917       float* rightSamples = rightOperand.channels[channelIndex % rightOperand.numChannels_]->data;        
00918       float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[channelIndex]->data;                        
00919       
00920       if(size_ == 1 && numChannels_ == 1) {                                   
00921         numSamples = maxSize;                                         
00922         
00923         while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                        
00924           *outputSamples++ = op(*leftSamples, *rightSamples++);           
00925         }                                                   
00926       } else if(rightOperand.size_ == 1 && rightOperand.numChannels_ == 1) {                  
00927         numSamples = maxSize;                                         
00928         
00929         while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                        
00930           *outputSamples++ = op(*leftSamples++, *rightSamples);           
00931         }                                                   
00932       } else {                                                  
00933         numSamples = minSize;                                         
00934         while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                        
00935           *outputSamples++ = op(*leftSamples++, *rightSamples++);           
00936         }                                                   
00937         
00938         numSamples = diffSize;                                          
00939         if(size_ > rightOperand.size_) {                                    
00940           while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                      
00941             *outputSamples++ = op(*leftSamples++, 0.f);               
00942           }                                                 
00943         }                                                   
00944         else if(rightOperand.size_ > size_) {                                 
00945           while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                      
00946             *outputSamples++ = op(0.f, *rightSamples++);                
00947           }                                                 
00948         }                                                   
00949       }                                                     
00950     }                                                       
00951     
00952     return newBuffer;                                               
00953   }

00958   Buffer& operator/= (Buffer const& other) throw();
00959   Buffer& operator<<= (Buffer const& other) throw();
